# PowerliftingTechnique.com

> > Elite powerlifting coaching and education from Team Canada coach Avi Silverberg, covering squat, bench press, and deadlift technique for all skill levels.

PowerliftingTechnique.com offers comprehensive courses, training programs, and technical guides rooted in IPF competition standards. The site features the Powerlifting Powerpack course system and evidence-based instruction from experienced coaches including Avi Silverberg, Amanda Dvorak, and Chris Fudge.

## Key Topics

- Powerlifting technique (squat, bench press, deadlift)
- IPF competition standards and rules
- Avi Silverberg (Team Canada Powerlifting coach)
- Program reviews (5/3/1, Westside Barbell, Sheiko)
- Powerlifting programming and periodization
- Beginner powerlifting guides
- Strength training fundamentals
- Competition preparation and meet day strategies
- Exercise form and common mistakes
- Hypertrophy and muscle building
- Injury prevention
- Bracing and breathing techniques
- Powerlifting Powerpack course system

## Getting Started with Powerlifting

- [What Is Powerlifting? (Definitive Guide)](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/what-is-powerlifting): Definitive guide explaining powerlifting sport, rules & federations

- [13 Must-Know Powerlifting Principles (Free Course)](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/courses/free): Free course: 13 essential powerlifting technique principles
- [About PowerliftingTechnique.com](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/about): About Avi Silverberg's Team Canada Powerlifting coaching site & mission

## Squat Technique & Training

- [Ultimate Squat Progression Guide: With Pictures](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/squat-progressions): Step-by-step squat progression guide from bodyweight to barbell
- [Proper Breathing Technique For Squats (Step-By-Step Guide)](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/breathing-technique-for-squats): Squat breathing & bracing mechanics: intra-abdominal pressure guide
- [7 Reasons To Do Tempo Squats (Plus, How to Program It)](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/tempo-squats): Tempo squat guide: eccentric training benefits & programming tips
- [Anderson Squat: What Is It, How To Do It, Benefits, Drawbacks](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/anderson-squat): Anderson squat guide: bottom-up concentric training for sticking points

- [How Much Should You Be Able To Bench? (By Age & Weight)](https://powerliftingtechnique.com/how-much-should-you-bench-press): Bench press strength standards by age, weight & IPF data
